row.description: Triggered when the player's ship comes within a distance of a dungeon object's surface. Fires immediately if already inside when started, and with keep listening fires again only after leaving and re-entering the range. A firing rejected by validation is retried each check while the ship stays inside. Waits, without polling, until the object is added to the ballpark. Range is polled twice a second while it is there, so a very small distance can be skipped at high ship speed.
row.name: Ship Within Range Of Dungeon Object

inputs.description: Dungeon object id to watch, matched against dunObjectID of objects in the ballpark
Distance in meters to the object's surface

outputs.description: Item id (ball id) of the matched dungeon object
Type id of the matched dungeon object
Dungeon object id of the matched object
Surface distance in meters when the event fired

row.description: Fraction of full fire rate a smart turret gun fires at on a target it has not been shooting. Ramps to 1.0 over turretFireRampDuration of fire. 1.0 disables the ramp.
row.name: turretFireRampStartRate

row.description: Milliseconds a target must be under fire from a base's smart turrets for the fire rate ramp to reach full rate. 0 disables the ramp.
row.name: turretFireRampDuration

row.description: Milliseconds a smart turret base keeps a target's fire rate ramp after it stops shooting that target, before the ramp starts to decay.
row.name: turretFireRampHoldDuration

row.description: Milliseconds over which a held fire rate ramp decays from full back to cold. 0 drops it to cold as soon as the hold ends.
row.name: turretFireRampDecayDuration

baseline.comment: The tank right now, read when gather_comet completes (3d3d60ac).

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: starts load_mining_lens after find_cutting_laser completes. The lens is looted with the laser, so loading it comes before firing it. On complete starts cut_and_refine_debris.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts load_mining_lens after find_cutting_laser completes. The lens is looted with the laser, so loading it comes before firing it. On complete starts use_cutting_laser.

target.comment: Activation flow: starts use_camera once the propulsion engine is online, the first beat of the creche sequence. On complete starts pilot_your_ship.

baseline.comment: Filters dungeon entry to Creche 14125, then re-arms both antenna listeners (5a61eeaa, 97be37ed) stopped on leaving, so a player who left before reaching an antenna still gets its goal on return. A no-op while a listener is still armed, and once its goal is complete.

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: starts dock_and_take_sensor when the ship comes within 4 km of the second creche antenna (1598093), any time after the tutorial starts. Its completion is what opens the contextual half.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts dock_and_take_sensor when install_leap_drive completes. Its completion is what opens the contextual half.

baseline.comment: On gather_comet complete: start refuel only if the tank is still at or below 50%. Above it, refuel would only flash up and vanish.

Activation flow: armed at graph start (root), so it is re-armed on every login, and again on entering the creche (1a680397). Starts dock_and_resupply once the ship is within 6 km of the Kitbash Framework Antenna placed in the creche (dungeon object 1598231, room 33250), whether or not the flight lessons are done. Fires straight away if the ship is already in range. Stops after firing, and on leaving the creche (73b75531); a start for an already completed goal is ignored. Also completes pilot_your_ship (ef1f1d00), whose only task is flying here, so the two cards hand over together.
Starts refuel_in_creche (Low on fuel!) when fuel is at or below 30% inside the creche. Completion is task-driven: dock at any quay, then refuel.

Stops both creche antenna listeners (5a61eeaa, 6 km; 97be37ed, 4 km) when the ship leaves Creche 14125, so they do not keep waiting for the antennas for the rest of the session. 1a680397 re-arms them on coming back.
Status effects lesson: listens for feralization building up. Armed at graph start (root), so the lesson can start at any point in the tutorial.

fieldChanges.baseline: Starts advanced_controls (Another way to fly) on undock from a Refuge, with build_network_node and improve_ship (24a38f17). The player switches flight mode four times and compares the two; a start for an already completed goal is ignored, so it shows once.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts advanced_controls when pilot_your_ship completes - flight assist on and off, and strafing.

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: starts view_memory when the player berths in their Refuge (atom 709 Berthing State Changed, validated by 708 Berthed; berthing is only possible at a Refuge). Validates on start, so a player already berthed when this arms or after a relog gets it too. Armed when dock_and_take_sensor completes - the contextual half. A start for a completed goal is ignored, so it shows once.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts view_memory the first time a Memory is generated (atom 730, OnMemoryCardPurchased). Armed when dock_and_take_sensor completes - the contextual half. No predicate; any generated Memory activates it.

fieldChanges.baseline: Starts view_memory. Completion is task-driven (Open Shell Sheet, task type 85), so there is no Complete Objective node.
fieldChanges.target: Starts view_memory. Completion is task-driven (Open Character Sheet, task type 86), so there is no Complete Objective node.

baseline.comment: Berthed: the berthing contract change put the player in a Refuge berth.
Status effects lesson: listens for heat building up. Armed at graph start (root), so the lesson can start at any point in the tutorial.

fieldChanges.baseline: is_not inverts the check, so this fires once the tank is ABOVE 50%. The completion threshold is deliberately higher than the 25% that starts the objective - the same value on both ends means one fuel tick satisfies both and the card flashes up and vanishes.
fieldChanges.target: is_not inverts the check, so this fires once the tank is ABOVE 60%. The completion threshold is deliberately higher than the 25% that starts the objective - the same value on both ends means one fuel tick satisfies both and the card flashes up and vanishes.

baseline.comment: Activation flow: armed at graph start (root), so it is re-armed on every login, and again on entering the creche (1a680397). Starts dock_and_take_sensor once the ship is within 4 km of the Kitbash Framework Antenna placed in the creche (dungeon object 1598093, room 33250), whether or not the leap lessons are done. Fires straight away if the ship is already in range. Stops after firing, and on leaving the creche (73b75531); a start for an already completed goal is ignored.

target.comment: Activation flow: starts use_cutting_laser after load_mining_lens completes - the lens is in the laser before the player is asked to fire it. On complete opens the crafting loop at refine_cinderwrack. continue_exploring and build_leap_module were deleted, so nothing else follows firing the laser.

baseline.comment: Creche dungeon entry, armed at graph start and kept listening. Feeds 1a680397, which re-arms both antenna listeners.

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: starts dock_and_resupply when the ship comes within 6 km of the creche antenna (1598231), any time after the tutorial starts - dock, refuel, take the leap drive, undock. On complete starts install_leap_drive, so the leap branch runs in order.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts dock_and_resupply when advanced_controls completes - dock, refuel, take the leap drive, undock. On complete starts install_leap_drive, so the leap branch runs in order.

baseline.comment: Activation flow: starts cut_and_refine_debris (Cut Debris) after load_mining_lens completes - the laser and lens are fitted, so the player cuts Debris from salvage. On complete starts refine_debris.
Status effects lesson: listens for temporal_drift building up. Armed at graph start (root), so the lesson can start at any point in the tutorial.
Low fuel split: in the creche (dungeon 14125) there is too little ore to make fuel, so start refuel_in_creche (dock at any quay and refuel); anywhere else start gather_comet (Source Fuel).

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: starts pilot_your_ship once the propulsion engine is online, the first beat of the creche sequence - fly to the Supply Docks, with the flight controls shown as hints. Starts nothing on complete: dock_and_resupply is started by the creche antenna proximity listener, which also completes this (ef1f1d00).

Activation flow: starts install_leap_drive when dock_and_resupply completes - open the install interface, fit the leap drive, then use it. Starts nothing on complete: dock_and_take_sensor is started by the second creche antenna proximity listener, which is armed at graph start. It no longer closes continue_exploring - that objective is deleted.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts install_leap_drive when dock_and_resupply completes - open the install interface, fit the leap drive, then use it. On complete starts dock_and_take_sensor. It no longer closes continue_exploring - that objective is deleted.

fieldChanges.baseline: Filters dungeon exit to Creche 14125, then starts gather_char after 10s and stops the creche antenna listener (73b75531). gather_slag no longer hangs off the exit - it follows resolve_signature inside the creche - the delayed build_first_module start went with that objective, and continue_exploring is deleted.
fieldChanges.target: Filters dungeon exit to Creche 14125, then starts gather_char after 10s. gather_slag no longer hangs off the exit - it follows resolve_signature inside the creche - the delayed build_first_module start went with that objective, and continue_exploring is deleted.

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: starts travel_first_destination after gather_slag completes - the player warps out before building the Refuge. On complete starts build_sanctuary. The crafting loop now opens off cut_and_refine_debris. On complete it also arms the use-a-kit listeners (ef162540/550/560), so Use a Thermal Salve, Use Psyche Inoculation and Use a Homeostatic Inoculation wait until the player has warped out of the creche; they validate on start, so an effect or Shell damage already present is caught then, and the relog replay re-arms them.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts travel_first_destination after build_sanctuary completes. It is the last objective in the chain - the player leaves the creche for good once the Refuge is up, so nothing follows it. The crafting loop now opens off use_cutting_laser.

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: starts build_sanctuary after travel_first_destination completes. It is the last objective in the chain; on complete it arms the fuel lesson.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts build_sanctuary after gather_slag completes. On complete starts travel_first_destination, the last objective in the chain - the Refuge is up, so the player leaves.

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: starts build_printed_circuit after refine_debris completes. Its output is an input to the Directional Scanner. On complete starts build_directional_scanner.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts build_printed_circuit after refine_cinderwrack completes. Its output is an input to the Directional Scanner. On complete starts build_directional_scanner.

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: starts gather_slag after resolve_signature completes - the scan resolves the Slag, then the player mines it, inside the creche. On complete starts travel_first_destination.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: starts gather_slag after resolve_signature completes - the scan resolves the Slag, then the player mines it, inside the creche. On complete starts build_sanctuary.

fieldChanges.baseline: Starts gather_comet (Source Fuel) when ship fuel remaining is at or below 30% outside the creche. Inside the creche (dungeon 14125) refuel_in_creche starts instead. On complete it checks the tank (3d3d60ac) and starts refuel only if it is still at or below 50%, so the player loads the D1 they just made; a refuel completed earlier passes straight through. On start arms the 50% listener (ef1f5f00) that completes it for a player who refuels another way.
fieldChanges.target: Starts gather_comet (Source Fuel) when ship fuel remaining is at or below 30%.

fieldChanges.baseline: Starts refuel (Refuel your ship) from two places: the 25% low-fuel check armed by build_sanctuary, and gather_comet (Source Fuel) completing. A refuel already completed is not restarted.

target.comment: Completion flow: completes use_cutting_laser when the fitted small cutting laser module is activated.

baseline.comment: Completion flow: completes pilot_your_ship when the ship comes within 6 km of the creche antenna (1598231) among the Supply Docks - the same moment dock_and_resupply starts.
Completion flow: armed when gather_comet starts. Listens for the tank climbing back, so the card does not stay up for a player who loads D1 as they make it or refuels at a dock.
is_not inverts the check, so this fires once the tank is ABOVE 50%, the same line refuel completes on.

Completion flow: completes gather_comet once the tank is back above 50%. gather_comet completing then finds the tank above 50% (3d3d60ac), so no refuel card starts. It does not complete refuel: a refuel not yet started would hold that completion and flash up and vanish the next time the tank hits 25%. A running refuel completes through its own 50% listener.

Activation flow: starts refine_debris (Refine Debris) after cut_and_refine_debris completes - the player refines the Debris they cut into the Silicon Dust and Nickel-Iron everything below needs. On complete starts build_printed_circuit.

Replay flow: armed at graph start (root). Starts the dock_and_resupply node once that goal is active or completed, so after a login away from the creche antenna the graph still passes through it to install_leap_drive and on. A first-time player still gets the card from the antenna (5a61eeaa); by the time this fires the node is already running, and a second start is ignored.

Replay flow: armed at graph start (root). Starts the dock_and_take_sensor node once that goal is active or completed, so after a login away from the second creche antenna the graph still passes through it to find_cutting_laser and arms the contextual cards. A first-time player still gets the card from the antenna (97be37ed); by the time this fires the node is already running, and a second start is ignored.

target.comment: Activation flow: starts refine_cinderwrack after travel_first_destination completes - refining Cinderwrack is the only source of Silicon Dust, which everything below needs. On complete starts build_printed_circuit.

fieldChanges.baseline: Activation flow: armed when build_sanctuary completes, so the fuel lesson only appears once the creche line is done. Starts refuel when the tank is at or below 25%.
fieldChanges.target: Activation flow: armed when travel_first_destination completes, so the fuel lesson only appears once the creche line is done. Starts refuel when the tank is at or below 25%.

baseline.comment: Starts understand_status_effects the first time any status effect builds up on the Shell. Its one row reads which effect at start; completion is task-driven.

descriptionID:
A payload deployed from a Launch Bay. On release it draws excess heat off your ship, then drifts and cools toward the surrounding temperature over its Cooling Period.

Destroying a Heat Trap vents its Stored Heat as a Thermal Discharge: radial thermal damage to every ship in range - allies and your own ship included. The hotter the trap when it dies, the stronger the discharge. While above its Volatility Threshold the trap is Volatile and cannot be scooped; once cooled below the threshold it turns inert and can be recovered.

Structurally fragile - any damage destroys it.

gatewayCompatibility.interpretation: Configured 3551616 skips the 3640684-only shared descriptor correction, causing legacy Notice.TargetGroup.user int64 bytes to be interpreted with target sint32 zigzag decoding. Trusted notice/request handling, Events.Publish wallet routing, economy dispatch and failed-request policy are also build-gated. This is a reason to design an explicit target compatibility profile, not blindly broaden every 3640684 gate.
gatewayCompatibility.scope: Focused source-level build gates affecting otherwise identical public protobuf schemas; no server or client was started.

# Python client comparison: 3640684 → 3551616 UMBRA

Recorded 2026-10-27. Direction throughout is the installed **3640684 baseline → supplied 3551616 target**, even though the target build number is earlier. Paths are recorded in `bytecode-inventory.json`. This audit reads the `stillness/code.ccp` archives; no client code was imported or executed.

## Method and scope

Both archives pass ZIP CRC verification and contain Python 3.12 bytecode magic `cb0d0d0a`. The existing preserved Windows CPython 3.12 runtime unmarshaled and disassembled the modules in a disposable Wine prefix, with read-only client/runtime grants and an output-directory write grant. Parsing produced no failures.

Structural comparison preserves bytecode, nested constants/code, argument and local/free/cell-variable layouts, flags, stack size and exception tables. It excludes the pyc header, source filename, first source line and line tables. A structural difference is evidence of code or constant changes, not proof of a distinct feature or of live gameplay compatibility. Source citations below refer to embedded bytecode source lines, not line numbers in the generated disassembly.

| Measure | 3640684 baseline | 3551616 target / delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Archive bytes | 119,398,148 | 118,673,614 |
| ZIP entries including duplicates | 11,684 | 11,602 |
| Unique member names | 11,679 | 11,597 |
| Unique `frontier/` names | 1,628 | 1,586 |
| Shared unique names | — | 11,594 |
| Added / removed unique names | — | 3 / 85 |
| Structurally changed shared members | — | 351 |
| Metadata-only changed shared members | — | 11,243 |
| Structurally changed shared `frontier/` members | — | 196 |
| Added / removed `frontier/` names | — | 2 / 44 |

Every shared member differs as raw bytes; most differences disappear when compilation metadata is excluded. Baseline SHA-256: `2f43f4b8d34632b5d5fdc7b58af93364f606bd9ba67fcada588565ee0628122c`. Target SHA-256: `77538f08bfa798fc87846606570dc09fd22d14a9781af3c6106758c78b4c1426`.

Each archive contains five duplicated names: `const.pyc`, `eveLocalization/__init__.pyc`, and `more_itertools/{__init__,more,recipes}.pyc`. Within an archive their occurrences can differ. The primary inventory uses `ZipFile.read(name)`, which resolves to the final occurrence. All ten corresponding occurrence pairs were also normalized and checked separately: all are equal across builds. The duplicate handling hides no extra code changes here.

The only three added unique members are `eveclientqatools/obstruction_cost.pyc`, `frontier/character_creation/demo.pyc`, and `frontier/docking_point/client/status_panel.pyc`. Removed families include Python flight-latency/RCS helpers, held/saved/wheel input helpers, FPS/heartbeat reporting, some progression/internal-event protobuf modules, three objective-task modules, the newer crown-weave ceremony/card helpers, and some bracket/camera/compass helpers. The exact 85-name list is in the inventory. Absence of telemetry/event messages does not establish removal of the player workflow itself.

## Concrete workflow changes

| Area | Baseline → target evidence | Practical implication |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Default flight controls | `frontier/navigation/client/beta.pyc:49–54` gives `active_input_scheme` default **`InputScheme.AIM_FLIGHT`**. Baseline uses `_default_input_scheme`, selecting A/AIM_FLIGHT by user-ID parity. This target differs from 3572727, whose default was A. Saved settings can override defaults. | Check the supplied target's initial controls and existing keybinding adapters. |
| Speed input | `frontier/navigation/const.pyc:8` replaces baseline `SPEED_FRACTION_RAMP_RATE=0.5` and `SPEED_FRACTION_WHEEL_STEP=0.02` with `SPEED_FRACTION_STEP=0.25`. Integration replaces ramp/wheel handlers with `_on_decrease_speed_executed:1049` and `_on_increase_speed_executed:1062`. `_handle_speed_fraction_request:601` retains `CmdSetSpeedFraction`, but lacks baseline's explicit request-throttler call. Python flight-latency, RCS-driver/layout/motion and speed-ramp modules are absent. | Validate speed stepping, input rate and native movement separately. Python helper removal does not remove the preserved rate/brake/heading RPCs. |
| Active scanning | `frontier/hud/scanner/state.pyc:_handle_mouse_wheel:344` checks Ctrl while active and adjusts angle using mouse-wheel increments. The scanner command/const/keyboard-angle modules are absent. `ScannerSystemContextAdapter.send_scan_request:150` still uses `directional_scan` or Creation `DIRECTIONAL_SCAN`, but lacks baseline's explicit MODULE_OFFLINE/MODULE_BUSY conversions; generic errors produce UNKNOWN_ERROR. Reticle wording becomes `ENERGY LOW`. | Scan RPCs remain present; controls and rejection presentation differ. |
| Docking readout and selection | New `status_panel.pyc`; docking service adds `_update_port_readout:395`, `_nearest_manual_port:440`, `_update_dock_selection:472`. It scans candidate ports every `PORT_SCAN_INTERVAL=2.0`, selects nearest within `PORT_APPROACH_RANGE=200.0`, and shows approach text outside `MANUAL_DOCK_RANGE=80.0`; within range it can auto-select the port and show docking availability. It preserves a current non-port selection. Constants are in `docking_point/common/const.pyc:153/178/188`. | Target has an older dedicated nearest-port/readout interaction. These are client UI thresholds, not proof of server acceptance ranges. |
| Undock during commit | Target `_undock_from_frame:881` directly calls `undock` when a point exists and undocking is not already in progress. Baseline tracks `_fully_docked` and `_undock_at_commit`, then defers the requested undock until `OnShipDockedToPoint`. Target removes that pending-commit flag. `_restore_dock_from_server:1138` keeps `get_docked_point` and undock-on-reconnect behavior, but changes status presentation. | Exercise cancel/undock timing and reconnect presentation against the target. |
| Composite mining reconciliation | Target `_reconcile_mined_set:1132` keeps bitset fetch/decompression and per-voxel visual replay, but lacks baseline native `get_grid`/`replay_mined`/`apply_mined_blob` replay and `OnCompositeMinedSetChanged` handler/subscription. `OnCompositeVoxelMined:1067` and `_fetch_mined_set:1108` are equal to baseline. Target `_fetch_recipe:53` still calls `GetCompositeRecipe`, but unconditionally caches the returned value, including None; baseline skips None. It lacks newer mesh-retry methods and recipe-type-ID palette handling. | Incremental voxel mining remains present. Missing-recipe retries, bulk replay and collision reconciliation require target-specific acceptance. |
| Regolith mapping | `spacecomponents/common/regolith_collapse.pyc:legacy_typeid:26` maps known families with `legs[int(regolith_typeid) % len(legs)]`. Baseline additionally preserves already-legacy IDs and handles REEF and Metallic special cases. | Same regolith IDs/families can map to different legacy resource types; catalog mapping needs review. |
| Scoop presentation | `ScoopChannelController.begin:255`, `_send_cancel:339`, and all of `CRRegolith` remain structurally equal. Target `scoop_hold_progress:150` accepts distance/start-distance/stop-range plus time parameters and returns `(progress, progress)`; baseline's helper accepts only time/peak inputs and returns a scalar. The new `pull_progress_from_range:137` helper exists, but the target `scoop_hold_progress` body does not call it. | Preserve BeginScoop/CancelScoop and `oreUnits` contracts; presentation helper changes do not establish server protocol changes or distance-driven progress. |
| Weapon selection | Target `SkillShotController._find_fitted_skill_shot_module_ids:222/237` takes only the first fitted single-shot module (`[:1]`) when no module is focused. Baseline can collect all fitted single-shot modules and accepts an optional module-ID filter. Target autocannon mode toggles one boolean; baseline tracks per-module auto-fire IDs and includes input ownership/parking helpers absent from target. | Multi-weapon and focus/toggle behavior differs. |
| Aim convergence | `frontier/aimed_action/client/convergence.pyc:20` adds `MIN_ACCEPT_RANGE_METERS=300.0`, passed into guard selection in `update:99`; skill-shot report generation changes accordingly. Held-beam failure wording becomes `ENERGY LOW`. | Check close-range targeting/report behavior. The 300m client constant does not prove a server firing minimum. |
| Exploration hydration | `ResolvedSystemSvc.ensure_system_hydrated:784` lacks baseline's `_detail_refused` cache and known/current-system guard. `wait_until_system_known:554` lacks refusal-grace handling. The target's cfg-universe shim lacks the baseline location guard and moon-specific orbit wrapper. Entire exploration messenger, generated UniverseDelta and schema metadata remain structurally equal. | Existing gateway/FlatBuffer shapes remain; refusal/retry and unknown-location behavior differ. Server disclosure rules remain necessary. |
| Progression/crown UI | Target `WeaveCrownView` uses left/right panels and direct remove/add transfers (`container.pyc:170/179`), lacking baseline's drag/hover preview handlers and `play_woven`. The newer ceremony/count/woven-card modules are absent. `split_for_weaving:113` lacks baseline's `prepick` argument. | UI/adapters differ; this alone does not establish removal of crown/ascension server functionality. |
| Status resync | Target `frontier/status_effect/client/service.pyc` lacks baseline `OnSessionReset` and `OnSessionChanged` handlers. | Verify status refresh on reconnect/character switches; the status-effect service is still packaged. |
| Public gateway selection | `publicGateway/grpc/connectionConfig.pyc:get_address:19` parses `FRONTIER_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_IS_SECURE` with `.strip().lower()` membership in `synonyms.ENABLED`; baseline uses `bool(string)`. Target also honors `frontierPublicGatewayIsSecure` global config with default true. Compiled host suffix is `.pub.evefrontier.com`, and target dev fallback is `origin-public-gateway.dev.pub.evefrontier.com` with secure false. Baseline fallback uses `.evefrontier.com` and different packaged/dev logic. | Launch/gateway configuration assumptions must match this build, especially textual false/0 handling. These are archived defaults, not a claim that the endpoints are currently live. |

## Exact preserved contracts and flags

MachoNet version remains **489** (`eve/common/script/net/eveMachoNetVersion.pyc:7`), and that complete module is structurally equal. The exact target navigation leaf methods `_handle_pitch_rate_request:623`, `_handle_roll_rate_request:678`, `_handle_brake_request:690`, and `_handle_heading_request:702` are equal to baseline; they retain `CmdSetPitchRate`, `CmdSetRollRate`, `CmdSetBrakeFraction`, and `CmdSetHeading`. Equality of these leaves does not prove native Destiny compatibility.

Docking `get_capabilities:245`, `_manual_dock_to:549`, and refuel pane `_handle_add_fuel:90` are structurally equal. Scoop `begin`/`_send_cancel`, complete CRRegolith, composite `_fetch_mined_set`/`OnCompositeVoxelMined`, exploration messenger, UniverseDelta and Universe schema metadata are equal; **Universe schema remains 14**. The recipe fetch leaf is changed only as described above, so it must not be listed as equal.

The entire `frontier/beta.pyc` module is structurally equal, including its direct constant assignments. That does not make the whole HUD/navigation configuration equal: target compass beta adds `multi_star_enabled` default true while `compass_strip_enabled` remains false, and target HUD beta lacks baseline `threat_corner_brackets`. Asset/module presence or a default flag does not prove server/runtime enablement.

## Evidence

- `bytecode-inventory.json`: hashes, counts, full member deltas and duplicate-occurrence proof.
- `archive-verification.json`: archive CRC and bytecode magic checks.
- `bytecode-symbol-changes.json`: complete changed/added symbol inventory with embedded lines, strings, names and literals.
- `bytecode-preserved-contracts.json`: exact normalized equality for the selected RPC leaves/modules.
- `extra-equality.json`: further whole-module equality checks, including `frontier/beta.pyc`.
- `bytecode-selected-dis.txt`, `extra-dis.txt`: focused CPython 3.12 disassembly supporting the workflow statements.
- `bytecode-frontier-dis.txt`: recursive disassembly of all changed/added/removed Frontier modules and selected related code.
- `bytecode_compare.py`, `bytecode_run.py`, `extra.py`, `extra_run.py`: reproducible comparison/disassembly workers and isolated-runtime launchers.

No client was activated and no gameplay was exercised by this analysis. Native libraries, resource/static data and protobuf descriptor differences are separate evidence streams in the main report.
